title: Parent runtime-component cache binds the NGINX release digest to a different tag archive
title_de: Parent-Runtime-Komponenten-Cache bindet den NGINX-Release-Digest an ein anderes Tag-Archiv
profile: Parent NGINX release-asset cache-identity source repair; final legitimate runtime proof remains blocked_environment
security_assessment: The original failure was a fail-closed supply-chain provenance mismatch, not an integrity bypass. The local Parent source correction now binds the exact pinned GitHub release tuple before download and preserves SHA-256 verification. It passed focused positive and bypass controls, but the legitimate preparation stops independently at missing_nginx_modsecurity_module (NGINX build exit 77), so the security-relevant release outcome remains blocked rather than fixed, verified, or closed.
security_assessment_de: Der ursprüngliche Fehler war ein fail-closed Supply-Chain-Provenance-Mismatch, kein Integrity-Bypass. Die lokale Parent-Source-Korrektur bindet nun das exakte gepinnte GitHub-Release-Tupel vor dem Download und bewahrt die SHA-256-Verifikation. Sie bestand fokussierte positive und Bypass-Controls, doch die legitime Vorbereitung stoppt unabhängig bei missing_nginx_modsecurity_module (NGINX-Build-Exit 77); daher bleibt das sicherheitsrelevante Release-Ergebnis blocked statt fixed, verified oder closed.
technical_claim: At the source base, the Parent runtime-component resolver selected the GitHub tag archive for release-1.31.2 while the configured NGINX_SHA256 authenticated the distinct GitHub release asset nginx-1.31.2.tar.gz. The local correction now requires a canonical HTTPS github.com repository, matching aliases, exact tag/ref, tag-derived asset name, and lower-case SHA-256 before deriving only the matching releases/download URL; the original mismatch no longer reproduces, but full runtime verification is blocked at the independent NGINX module build prerequisite.
entry_point: Parent runtime-component NGINX source selection before archive download and cache admission
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: At the source base, resolve_nginx_archive returned /archive/refs/tags/<tag>.tar.gz and prepare_archive applied the reviewed release-asset digest, so the checksum correctly rejected different bytes. The correction exports the configured asset name and digest, validates the complete immutable release tuple in nginx_release_asset_identity, derives only /releases/download/<tag>/<asset>, and retains URL-inclusive cache identity; the next independent control boundary reports missing_nginx_modsecurity_module rather than sha256_mismatch.
attacker_prerequisites: A runtime-evidence execution uses the configured github-release NGINX source mode.
The reviewed release-asset SHA-256 is configured for the selected release tag.
observed_behavior: The isolated PR #55 evidence preparation recorded NGINX status corrupt with blocker_reason sha256_mismatch. It downloaded https://github.com/nginx/nginx/archive/refs/tags/release-1.31.2.tar.gz, observed d886473e988ce6802d897310421e3ef038c06edc66c5424cd33ed1b15382e323, and expected af2a957c41da636ddc4f883e4523c6d140b4784dbce42000c364ae5092aa473c for the release asset. The final local candidate instead recorded archive status present, checksum_status PASS, the exact releases/download URL, and matching expected/observed SHA-256; it then stopped independently at missing_nginx_modsecurity_module with NGINX build exit 77.
expected_behavior: For github-release mode, Parent must derive and use the exact reviewed GitHub release-asset URL https://github.com/nginx/nginx/releases/download/release-1.31.2/nginx-1.31.2.tar.gz whose identity matches the configured tag, asset name, repository, and SHA-256. It must reject malformed or inconsistent configured identity rather than falling back to a tag archive or changing the digest.
impact: The checksum gate prevents an unverified archive from being used, so no integrity bypass was observed. The original cache-identity cause is now locally remediated and the reviewed asset is acquired and verified, but NGINX provisioning still stops at the separate missing-module build prerequisite. FND-CROSS-0001 therefore still lacks the required current full runtime evidence and Parent PR #55 integration remains blocked.
preconditions: NGINX_RELEASE_TAG and NGINX_SOURCE_GIT_REF are release-1.31.2, NGINX_RELEASE_ASSET_NAME is nginx-1.31.2.tar.gz, and NGINX_SHA256 is the reviewed lower-case release-asset digest.
reproduction: Use the isolated Parent evidence worktree and task-owned output roots to run make prepare-runtime-components.

At the source base, inspect the retained runtime-component manifest for nginx.archive status corrupt and blocker_reason sha256_mismatch and compare the tag-archive URL with the reviewed GitHub release asset and configured SHA-256.

On the corrected candidate, inspect the final runtime manifest for archive status present, checksum_status PASS, the exact releases/download URL, matching expected/observed SHA-256, and the subsequent missing_nginx_modsecurity_module boundary.

evidence.summary: The manifest records the selected tag archive URL, expected release-asset digest, observed tag-archive digest, and fail-closed sha256_mismatch.

evidence.command: isolated make prepare-runtime-components with task-owned source, cache, build, log, and evidence roots; it reached the independent NGINX connector-build boundary
evidence.summary: The archive is present and SHA-256 PASS at the exact release-download URL with tag/ref release-1.31.2 and asset nginx-1.31.2.tar.gz. The run then stops at the independent missing_nginx_modsecurity_module condition.

evidence.command: RTK-proxied final local validation; exact commands and their outcomes are retained in the receipt
evidence.summary: The receipt records source hardening, 31 passing focused cache/provenance tests, shell syntax, variable documentation, bilingual unit tests, whitespace review, independent review, runtime checksum success, and the exact blocked native/runtime and Framework-documentation prerequisites.

root_cause: Parent resolve_nginx_archive always constructed a GitHub tag-archive URL in github-release mode. Its shell wrapper did not pass the already configured NGINX_RELEASE_ASSET_NAME into the Python environment, so the resolver could not construct and validate the corresponding release-download URL. The Framework's direct NGINX provisioner already uses the correct release-asset URL; this was a separate Parent cache-provider defect.
proposed_remediation: Implemented locally: export the existing NGINX_RELEASE_ASSET_NAME and NGINX_SHA256 to the Parent resolver; require a safe exact GitHub release-download URL derived from the configured repository, tag, and asset name; preserve the reviewed SHA-256; reject malformed/inconsistent identities before download; and cover resolver plus cache-identity regressions. The implementation has no tag-archive or latest-release fallback. Next, provide the missing NGINX module prerequisite and rerun the legitimate native/runtime preparation before any delivery or stronger lifecycle claim.
acceptance_criteria: A fixed github-release configuration resolves exactly to the reviewed GitHub release-asset URL without a latest lookup.
The configured tag, repository, asset name, and URL path are mutually consistent; malformed host, repository, tag, or asset values fail closed before download.
The reviewed release-asset SHA-256 remains unchanged and is applied to that exact URL.
Focused Parent cache-contract tests cover the legitimate control and inconsistent identity bypass attempts.

An isolated runtime-component preparation reaches the component build path without this checksum mismatch; the manifest shows checksum_status PASS for the reviewed release asset and the separate missing-module/Framework blockers remain independently assessed.
validation_plan: Provision the missing NGINX module prerequisite in an authorized environment and rerun the same legitimate isolated runtime preparation.
Repeat native NGINX module/runtime and downstream FND-CROSS-0001 legitimate controls after the missing prerequisite is available.
Rerun Framework-dependent documentation checks only with the Framework boundary available through an authorized route; do not initialize or modify it from this Parent task.
Only if all required local controls pass, create a separate Parent delivery candidate and then perform exact-head review, CI, SonarQube Cloud, and resulting-master verification.
legitimate_control_tests: Configured github-release NGINX tag release-1.31.2 plus asset nginx-1.31.2.tar.gz resolves to its matching releases/download URL without network discovery.
A cache entry with the old tag-archive URL is not reused for the release-asset URL even when the filename is the same.
bypass_review: Independent review confirmed that foreign/non-HTTPS repositories, inconsistent aliases/tag/ref/asset/digest, tag-archive fallback, percent-encoded/reserved path components, dot segments, malformed owner names, and overlong repository components fail closed. The final review found no remaining concrete GitHub URL parser/canonicalization bypass. The SHA-256 mismatch control remains fail-closed.
dependencies: GitHub release asset availability for the reviewed NGINX release
A later Framework provenance repair tracked separately as FND-FRAMEWORK-0030
An authorized environment with a usable ngx_http_modsecurity_module build prerequisite
blocked_by: missing_nginx_modsecurity_module (NGINX connector build exit 77 after successful release-asset checksum verification)
Framework-dependent broad documentation checks cannot resolve existing links while the Framework gitlink is intentionally uninitialized
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-FRAMEWORK-0006. That Framework record covers an earlier direct-provisioner archive-digest issue and its Framework release-asset control is already correct. This record owns the distinct Parent runtime-cache resolver that selects a different tag archive while retaining the release-asset digest.
evidence_limitations: The observed failure proves a fail-closed cache admission mismatch, not a successful integrity bypass.
A local Parent source repair and focused evidence exist, but no branch update, pull request, or merge has occurred.
The corrected preparation has not completed the native NGINX module build because of missing_nginx_modsecurity_module (exit 77).
A successful runtime component preparation alone will not satisfy FND-CROSS-0001; the full legitimate current evidence chain remains required.
residual_risk: The reviewed release asset now reaches and passes the Parent cache integrity boundary, but the host does not prove the complete NGINX module build or downstream runtime matrix. A deployment/build integration defect could remain undiscovered despite the focused resolver, cache, documentation, and bypass controls. Parent PR #55 remains blocked pending the missing module prerequisite, the separate Framework repair, fresh full evidence, and an exact-head delivery cycle. The digest control must not be weakened.

history.detail: The registered isolated PR #55 evidence run recorded the NGINX GitHub tag archive against the distinct configured release-asset digest and stopped fail-closed at sha256_mismatch.

Read-only comparison confirmed Framework's direct NGINX provisioner already constructs the correct release-download URL. The required correction is Parent-owned; no digest change, control bypass, delivery action, or Parent gitlink change was made.

The local Parent candidate exports and validates the pinned release tuple, derives only the exact GitHub release-download URL, retains URL-inclusive cache identity, rejects malformed/canonicalization-bypass inputs, and passed 31 focused cache/provenance tests plus focused documentation and review controls. The legitimate preparation now records checksum_status PASS and matching release-asset SHA-256, then stops independently at missing_nginx_modsecurity_module with NGINX build exit 77. No delivery action occurred.
